notes: The spike integrates the official ERC-7984 wrapper and compiles both single-contract and split-custody tests.
Official ERC-7984 source inspection shows that an underfunded transfer returns an encrypted zero rather than publicly reverting.
The spike therefore requires a public proof of an encrypted exact-budget equality before exposing funded state or allowing settlement.
The proof reveals only whether escrow equals the already-public ceiling; confidential balance and settlement values remain unsaved.
The official plugin stopped before tests because it could not connect to a Docker daemon. No mock runtime or success fallback was used.
